title: Middleware pipeline in one screen
rememberThis: Onion model: registration order is outside-in; code after await _next unwinds reverse — like Express next().
Order checklist: exception handler → routing → authentication → authorization → endpoints.
Never inject scoped DbContext in middleware constructor — InvokeAsync parameter or IMiddleware only.
Map/Run short-circuit branches — middleware after Map on main branch does not run for mapped paths.
UseExceptionHandler + Problem Details in production; DeveloperExceptionPage dev-only.
bullets: RequestDelegate _next is the next link; omitting await _next stops the pipeline (short-circuit).
UseRouting must run before UseAuthorization so [Authorize] binds to the selected endpoint.
IExceptionHandler (.NET 8) maps exceptions to RFC 7807 JSON with correlationId extensions.
IMiddlewareFactory activates IMiddleware per request — safe scoped constructor injection.
ValidateOnBuild / ValidateScopes catches captive dependencies at startup in CI.
Health checks: Map /health before auth or probes get 401 and Kubernetes restarts pods.
